signals.text: 2 new PM roles posted this week

bullets: Identify strategic client objectives and opportunities to strengthen partnerships and expand product value.
Support ongoing client requirements, product planning, and roadmap definition.
Gather, document, and prioritize client needs, preparing Business Requirements Documents (BRDs) and securing agreement on deliverables.
Manage product-related client deliverables by scoping and maintaining BRDs, translating requirements into Statements of Work (SOWs), and tracking project activities, timelines…
Collaborate with Technical Leads to define detailed solution designs and agree on implementation approaches.

roles.title: AI Product Lead - Employee Benefits, Financial Services & Sales

bullets: Develop and execute AI strategies and roadmaps for Employee Benefits and Financial Services, aligned with practice objectives, technology systems, and growth priorities.
Partner with practice leaders to identify, evaluate, prioritize, and implement practical AI use cases.
Support AI adoption across Sales teams to improve productivity, client engagement, and commercial effectiveness.
Establish and manage AI operating processes, including initiative intake, prioritization, budget recommendations, and progress reporting.
Oversee the AI initiative portfolio, determining which projects should be prioritized, scaled, redesigned, or discontinued.
